title: BLS12-381 G1 plain DLP: deterministic BSGS baseline

claims.statement: For a uniform scalar x in 0..r-1 and T=[x]P0 in BLS12-381 G1, the deterministic baby-step/giant-step attack in proof.md recovers x with probability 1 using at most 2^129.428545 target-group-operation equivalents (C=2000; one unit is a reference G1 addition). Memory is m=ceil(sqrt(r)) affine G1 points, below 2^134.013507 bytes; preprocessing is m baby additions and is included in the 4m charge; advice is zero. The score is the rounded-up log2 of the complete 4m bound (m baby additions, m giant additions, m hash insertions, m hash lookups, verification). This is a generic analytic baseline, not a production execution or practical break.
